tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to hire
1a) (Qal) to hire
1b) (Niphal) to hire oneself out
1c) (Hithpael) to earn wages
Also means: sa.khar (סָכַר "to hire" H7936A)

strongs_1890.derivation: or (by permutation) סָכַר; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to H3739 (כָּרָה) through the idea of temporary purchase; compare H7937 (שָׁכַר));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.
